_how_this_works: One entry per painted piece. The site uses the painting if its file is in this folder, and the code-drawn version if not.
file   = the picture's filename in assets/, without .png
anchor = the spot in the picture that gets pinned to the actor's position: [across, down], 0–1. [0.5, 0.5] is the middle, [0.5, 1] is bottom-centre.
scale  = how wide the whole picture is drawn, as a multiple of Catto's size (1 = as wide as Catto's box). Exceptions are said in the note.
rotate = optional, degrees, turns the picture clockwise.
points = optional extra spots in the picture [across, down] that code effects attach to (a glowing eye, the angler's stalk).
Save this file while `npm run dev` is running and the page reloads with the new numbers.

catto-sit.note: anchor = middle of his head; it is pinned to the centre of the helmet. Used on the pier.

catto-swim.note: anchor = middle of his head. Used from the jump onwards.

catto-swim-shocked.note: anchor = middle of his head. Shown after a scare.

catto-swim-happy.note: anchor = middle of his head. Shown at the treasure and on the ride up.

anemone-back.note: anchor = where it sits on the rock

anemone-front.note: front row only, drawn over the clownfish

sardine.note: facing right; reused for the whole shoal

turtle.note: swimming left; anchor = middle of the shell (Catto rides just above it)

boulder.note: scale is × each boulder's own width (they come in many sizes), not × Catto

coral-frond.note: anchor = base, where it grows from the rock

urchin.note: anchor = where it rests on the rock

manta.note: from above, head right; anchor = middle of the body (not the tail). Shrinks a little on narrow screens.

shark.note: facing right; anchor = middle of the body. points.eye = where the green eye-glow goes.

squid.note: mantle pointing right, arms trailing left; anchor = just behind the eye

angler-closed.note: facing left; anchor = middle of the body. points.stalkTip = end of the stalk; the glowing lure hangs from there.

chest-closed.note: anchor = bottom-centre, where it sits on the sand. Needs chest-open too.

chest-open.note: fades in over the closed one as it opens

pearls-gems.note: two piles beside the chest; replaces the loose code-drawn pearls and gems

bg-sky.note: scale is × the screen width, not × Catto. anchor = bottom-left, pinned to the waterline.

pier.note: anchor = the top of the deck at the far (right-hand) end of the pier
